description_en: Queries the associations of mitigation policies
description_zh: 查询防护策略关联关系
name: ListPolicyAttachment

parameters.help_en:
The policy type. Valid values:
default: default mitigation policy.
l3: IP-specific mitigation policy.
l4: port-specific mitigation policy
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型，取值
default：表示默认防护策略
l3：表示IP防护策略
l4：表示端口防护策略
parameters.name: policy_type

fields.help_en: The IP address of the protected object
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en: The port number of the protected object
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The port number range of the protected object
fields.help_zh: 防护对象的端口号范围
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

tcp: Transmission Control Protocol.
udp: User Datagram Protocol
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

tcp：表示传输控制协议。
udp：表示用户数据报协议
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of rows per page in a paging query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

Not specified: queries the policy associations that attach to the default surf DPI engine.
2: queries the policy associations that attach to the new stream DPI engine
parameters.help_zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

不填：查询默认 surf 防护引擎策略绑定。
2：查询新版 stream 防护引擎策略绑定
parameters.name: port_version
